prompt:
Implement the VCF Operations for Logs 9.0 log-forwarder update integration in this Go module. The normalized, source-pinned contract is in docs/contract.json and its official provenance is in docs/official_sources.json; use the single operation it names, PUT_log-forwarder-id. Do not substitute the VCF 9.1 Log Management API or a documentation-page contract.

Complete the vcflogs client and the mock package using only the Go standard library. Client.UpdateForwarder must send one authenticated PUT request to /api/v2/log-forwarder/{id} and decode the successful response. A caller may invoke the same method again after an ambiguous 500 response, and that repeated call must converge without creating a second effect. Required JSON fields must always be present, including sslEnabled when false. Every unset optional request field must be omitted; explicitly set false, zero, and empty-string optionals must still be sent.

Complete the loopback mock so it loads and validates docs/contract.json, serves only the operation named there, records the exact method, request URI, Content-Type, Accept, Authorization, and body for every request, and exposes both a snapshot of that request log and the number of semantic state changes. Its first valid update must apply the state and return 500; a subsequent identical call must return 200 without incrementing the effect count. The mock and all verification must remain loopback-only and must never contact a VMware endpoint.

Add table-driven Go tests covering the minimal request and explicitly set zero-value optionals, exact wire encoding, repeated-call safety, and single-effect semantics. The repository must pass ./verify.sh, which runs go test -race ./....
